# coolify_database (Resource)

A standalone database. The `engine` attribute selects among the eight engines Coolify supports; only set the engine-specific attributes matching your engine (Coolify rejects the others). Credentials left unset are generated by Coolify and exported as attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_database" "pg" {
  engine           = "postgresql"
  project_uuid     = coolify_project.example.uuid
  environment_name = "production"
  server_uuid      = coolify_server.example.uuid

  name        = "app-db"
  postgres_db = "app"

  instant_deploy = true
}

output "database_url" {
  value     = coolify_database.pg.internal_db_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) Database engine: `postgresql`, `mysql`, `mariadb`, `mongodb`, `redis`, `keydb`, `dragonfly` or `clickhouse`. Changing it forces replacement.
- `project_uuid` (String) UUID of the project. Changing it forces replacement.
- `server_uuid` (String) UUID of the server. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `clickhouse_admin_password` (String, Sensitive) Clickhouse admin password (clickhouse engine).
- `clickhouse_admin_user` (String, Sensitive) Clickhouse admin user (clickhouse engine).
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `destination_uuid` (String) Destination UUID (required when the server has several).
- `dragonfly_password` (String, Sensitive) Dragonfly password (dragonfly engine).
- `environment_name` (String) Environment name. Exactly one of `environment_name`/`environment_uuid`.
- `environment_uuid` (String) Environment UUID.
- `image` (String) Docker image override (e.g. `postgres:16-alpine`).
- `instant_deploy` (Boolean) Start the database right after creation. Defaults to `false`.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Expose the database on a public port. Defaults to `false`.
- `keydb_password` (String, Sensitive) KeyDB password (keydb engine).
- `limits_cpus` (String) CPU limit (e.g. `0.5`).
- `limits_memory` (String) Memory limit (e.g. `512m`).
- `mariadb_database` (String) Initial database name (mariadb engine).
- `mariadb_password` (String, Sensitive) MariaDB user password (mariadb engine).
- `mariadb_root_password` (String, Sensitive) MariaDB root password (mariadb engine).
- `mariadb_user` (String) MariaDB user (mariadb engine).
- `mongo_initdb_database` (String) Initial database name (mongodb engine).
- `mongo_initdb_root_password` (String, Sensitive) MongoDB root password (mongodb engine).
- `mongo_initdb_root_username` (String, Sensitive) MongoDB root username (mongodb engine).
- `mysql_database` (String) Initial database name (mysql engine).
- `mysql_password` (String, Sensitive) MySQL user password (mysql engine).
- `mysql_root_password` (String, Sensitive) MySQL root password (mysql engine).
- `mysql_user` (String) MySQL user (mysql engine).
- `name` (String) Database name. Coolify generates one when omitted.
- `postgres_conf` (String) Base64-encoded postgresql.conf (postgresql engine).
- `postgres_db` (String) Initial database name (postgresql engine).
- `postgres_password` (String, Sensitive) PostgreSQL password (postgresql engine).
- `postgres_user` (String, Sensitive) PostgreSQL user (postgresql engine).
- `public_port` (Number) Host port when `is_public` is `true`.
- `redis_password` (String, Sensitive) Redis password (redis engine).

### Read-Only

- `external_db_url` (String, Sensitive) Public connection URL when `is_public` is enabled.
- `internal_db_url` (String, Sensitive) Connection URL usable from other resources on the same destination.
- `status` (String) Runtime status reported by Coolify.
- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
